facts.summary: Nasdaq delisting notice, trading suspended to OTC · Phase 1b/2 · pepinemab in Alzheimer's, cancer · not yet approved
facts.indication: Alzheimer's disease, head and neck cancer, pancreatic cancer

evidence.summary: the Nasdaq Hearings Panel has determined to delist the Company's shares from Nasdaq due to the Company's failure to meet Nasdaq's continued listing standards.
evidence.safety: Pepinemab appears to have been well-tolerated with a favorable safety profile in multiple clinical trials in different neurological and cancer indications.
